patch_description: The pure soft-min objective collapses all gradient mass onto the single bottleneck triangle, which strands other near-degenerate triangles at the 0.02 plateau. Adding a second gradient phase that minimizes a soft τ-quantile of the 286 areas (τ ≈ 0.05–0.10) spreads gradient weight across the whole weak tail, matching the true "maximize the minimum" structure better and letting the plateau break. I add a differentiable quantile surrogate via a soft indicator (sigmoid on area − threshold), take its exact gradient with respect to points, and run it as an Adam phase on the incumbent best configuration before the final polish. The surrogate uses a threshold annealed from the min area upward, so it focuses on exactly the bottom ~5–10% of triangles.
